inputs.text: I heard this update on the West Asia conflict, where former Israeli PM advisor Daniel Rubenstein says a political resolution is vital for success but stresses Israel's unwavering stance against Iran's nuclear and missile programs, calling it an ongoing operation. This is exactly why we need strong national resolve and traditional authority to stand firm against radical regimes that threaten order and our way of life. Progressive attacks blaming Israel for power structures and inequalities only push weak diplomacy that erodes security and invites more aggression, rather than the personal responsibility and cultural continuity that have always protected nations from such enemies.
